sq.q: \(\text{A bar of length } l \text{ has ends kept at } 0^\circ\text{C} \text{ and } 100^\circ\text{C} \text{ until steady state. Then ends are suddenly reduced to } 0^\circ\text{C}. \text{ Find } u(x,t).\)
answer: \(\text{General solution: } u(x,t)=\sum_{n=1}^\infty B_n \sin\frac{n\pi x}{l} e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t/l^2}.\)
\(\text{Fourier sine coefficients: } B_n = \frac{2}{l} \int_0^l \frac{100}{l} x \sin\frac{n\pi x}{l} dx = \frac{200}{n\pi}(-1)^{n+1}.\)

sq.q: \(\text{A bar of length } l \text{ has ends kept at } 30^\circ\text{C} \text{ and } 80^\circ\text{C} \text{ until steady state. Then ends are changed to } 40^\circ\text{C} \text{ and } 60^\circ\text{C}. \text{ Find } u(x,t).\)
answer: \(\text{Let } u(x,t)=u_1(x)+u_2(x,t), \text{ where } u_2 \text{ satisfies heat equation with zero ends.}\)
\(\text{Solve for } u_2 \text{ using Fourier sine series: } u_2(x,t)=\sum_{n=1}^\infty B_n \sin\frac{n\pi x}{l} e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t/l^2}.\)
\(\text{Find } B_n \text{ from } \frac{30}{l}x - 10 = \sum B_n \sin\frac{n\pi x}{l}. \text{ Then } u(x,t)=u_1(x)+u_2(x,t).\)

lq.q: \(\text{A rod of length 10 cm has ends $A$ and $B$ kept at $50^\circ$ $C$ and $100^\circ$ $C$ until steady state.}\\ \text{Then the temperature at $A$ is raised to $90^\circ$C and at B is lowered to $60^\circ$C.}\\ \text{Find the subsequent temperature distribution.}\)
answer: Step Marks \(\text{Initial steady state: \(u_{s1}(x)= 50 + 5x\) (since gradient \((100-50)/10=5\)).}\) (2 Marks) \(\text{Final steady state (after change): \(u_{s2}(x)= 90 - 3x\) (since \((60-90)/10 = -3\), so \(u=90-3x\)).}\) (2 Marks) \(\text{Let \(u(x,t)= u_{s2}(x) + v(x,t)\), \(v\) satisfies heat equation with zero BCs: \(v(0,t)=0\), \(v(10,t)=0.\)}\) (2 Marks) \(\text{Initial: \(u(x,0)= u_{s1}(x)= u_{s2}(x)+v(x,0)\) \(\Rightarrow\) \(v(x,0)= u_{s1} - u_{s2} = (50+5x) - (90-3x) = -40 + 8x.\)}\) (3 Marks) \(\text{Solve for \(v\): \(v(x,t)= \sum B_n \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t / 100}.\)}\) (2 Marks) \(\text{\(B_n = \dfrac{2}{10} \int_0^{10} (-40+8x) \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) dx.\)}\) (2 Marks) \(\text{Compute integrals: \(\int \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) dx = -\dfrac{10 \cos\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right)}{n\pi}\), \(\int x \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) dx = \left[ -\dfrac{10x \cos\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right)}{n\pi} + \dfrac{100}{n^2\pi^2} \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) \right].\)}\) (3 Marks) \(\text{Combine to get \(B_n.\) Then \(u(x,t)= 90 - 3x + \sum B_n \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{10}\right) e^{-\alpha^2 n^2\pi^2 t / 100}.\)}\) (1 Mark)
